method: Derived survey estimates, not an AHRQ-published league table. Drug ranks: sum of person weights over prescription-purchase events, grouped by public-use RXDRGNAM (some names are anonymized therapeutic classes). Condition ranks: weighted unique people per reported CCSR category across CCSR1X-CCSR4X, associated with medical care; not prevalence of all disease in America. Rank is point-estimate order; overlapping intervals do not establish a difference. Taylor stratified-PSU total standard errors include zero-contribution PSUs from the full positive-weight person sample. Filter: at least 30 unweighted people and relative standard error at most 30%. Equipment, invalid names, non-condition FAC/EXT codes and unmapped categories are excluded. No synthetic padding to reach 1,000.
